question: In the realm of soil science, humus is considered:
solution:
The correct answer is __**decaying organic matter in soil**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Humus** is the dark, organic material in soils, produced by the decomposition of vegetable or animal matter and essential to the **fertility of the earth**.
 
• It is a critical component for soil health, providing nutrients and enhancing the soil’s ability to retain moisture.
